name: Atomistic & Multiscale Modelling of Materials
description: Introduction to simulation and modelling; interatomic potentials; short and long range forces; atomic definition of pressure and temperature: equation of state; monte carlo methods: precipitation; energy minimization; molecular dynamics simulations; introduction to machine learning for simulations; machine learned interatomic potentials; upscaling results from molecular dynamics; benchmarking and evaluation of potentials; some examples including modeling of fracture, and impact.
